title: Anagram Check
story: Are two words made of exactly the same letters?
goal: Write is_anagram(a, b): True if b is a rearrangement of a (ignore case).
hints: If two words are anagrams, their sorted letters are equal.

def is_anagram(a, b):
    return sorted(a.lower()) == sorted(b.lower())
socratic: What is the same about two anagrams?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Anagram Check”?
solution:
def is_anagram(a, b):
    return sorted(a.lower()) == sorted(b.lower())
